title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: expanded user profile in alerts
summary: The briefing passes: the documented profile fields, privacy gate, permissions and control routes are supported by Microsoft sources. It accurately distinguishes the roadmap's launched status from Learn's preview labels, and limits its licensing and automation gaps to what is not documented.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Username anonymisation is controlled in Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Insider Risk Management > Privacy > Show anonymized versions of usernames.
claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page. ... Select Insider Risk Management to go to the Insider Risk Management settings. ... Select Privacy. ... Select the option you want, to show anonymized names or not. ... Show anonymized versions of usernames

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell call for setting username anonymisation is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management username anonymization privacy Set-InsiderRiskManagementConfig PowerShell Microsoft Graph; Insider Risk Management anonymization PowerShell Set. Read Learn results and the full Privacy page; only portal configuration was documented.

claims.claim: Role group membership is configured in Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > Insider Risk Management > Edit > Choose users.
claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page, select Roles and groups, then select Roles groups in the left navigation pane. ... Select the Insider Risk Management role group, then select Edit. ... Select Choose users

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "<role-group>" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to a role group and grants its effective permissions.
claims.quote: When you add a member to a role group, the member is given the effective permissions provided by the management roles assigned to the role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.where: controls[2]; summary; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate expanded-profile switch or individual-attribute visibility control.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management expanded profile switch disable; expanded user profile enable disable setting; username anonymization PowerShell Microsoft Graph. Read Learn results, activities, users and Privacy. Only the username Privacy gate was documented.

claims.where: controls[0].scope; controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: The tenant Privacy option applies to all policies and all users with current and past policy matches rather than selected fields or users.
claims.quote: Choosing this setting anonymizes all users with current and past policy matches and applies to all policies. ... User profile information in the insider risk alert and case details won't be available when this option is chosen.

claims.claim: The Privacy page requires an admin account in the Microsoft 365 organisation to change the setting.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal with an admin account in your Microsoft 365 organization.

claims.claim: Role group changes require assignment permissions, including those held by Microsoft Entra Global Administrator and Compliance Administrator.
claims.quote: Members of the following roles can assign users to Insider Risk Management role groups and have the same solution permissions included with the Insider Risk Management Admins role group: ... Microsoft Entra ID Global Administrator ... Microsoft Entra ID Compliance Administrator

claims.claim: Role group permissions may take up to 30 minutes to apply.
claims.quote: After configuring your role groups, it might take up to 30 minutes for the role group permissions to apply to assigned users across your organization.

claims.claim: Exported alerts expose usernames through the exporting API even when anonymisation is enabled.
claims.quote: anonymization of usernames isn't preserved for exported alerts when using the exporting API or when exporting to Microsoft Purview eDiscovery solutions. Exported alerts display usernames for each alert in this case.

claims.claim: Exported alerts expose usernames through eDiscovery export even when anonymisation is enabled.
claims.quote: anonymization of usernames isn't preserved for exported alerts when using the exporting API or when exporting to Microsoft Purview eDiscovery solutions. Exported alerts display usernames for each alert in this case.

claims.claim: CSV exports from alerts or cases preserve username anonymisation.
claims.quote: If you export to CSV files from alerts or cases, anonymization is preserved.

claims.claim: Learn documents administrative-unit scoping for alerts and users, not selection of expanded-profile fields.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management expanded user profile administrative units anonymization; read Learn results, permissions' admin-unit section and activities' scoping and profile sections. Scoping limits alerts and user data; no profile-field selection was documented.

claims.claim: The permissions page gives no administrative-unit configuration path specific to expanded-profile fields.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management expanded user profile administrative units; read the full insider-risk-management-permissions page. Its admin-unit section describes role-member scoping and links to general admin units, not a configuration path for profile fields.

claims.claim: Learn does not explain how HR Connector last working date relates to a differing Entra last working date in the expanded profile.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management expanded user profile HR Connector last working date Entra difference; read activities and users profile sections and HR connector search excerpts. Both signals are listed, but no precedence or discrepancy handling is described.

claims.claim: Learn documents no way to show expanded-profile details while retaining username anonymisation.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management expanded user profile administrative units anonymization; expanded profile switch disable; username anonymization PowerShell Microsoft Graph. Read results, activities, users and Privacy. The documented gate hides the expanded profile.

controlChecks.governs: Whether usernames are anonymised, which hides the expanded user profile
